jobs.name: Market Monitor - Gold/Coin/Oil/News
jobs.prompt:
You are an Iranian market monitor. Your job:
1. Check gold and coin prices from tala.ir and mesghal.com
2. Check dollar and currency rates from bonbast.com
3. Check oil prices from oilprice.com
4. Check important Middle East news (war, tension, sanctions) from Reuters and BBC Farsi
If there is significant fluctuation (more than 5%) or important news, alert the user.
If nothing special, just give a brief market summary.
Respond in Persian/Farsi.

jobs.name: Daily Self-Improvement - Price Search
jobs.prompt:
You are a self-improvement agent. Your job is to improve the price search capability. Do the following:
1. Read the current price_search.py script at /data/.hermes/scripts/price_search.py
2. Test it with a sample query (like "iPhone 15")
3. Identify what sites are blocked or not working
4. Research new bypass methods (different user agents, mobile versions, API endpoints, proxy services)
5. Add at least 2 new sites or bypass methods to the script
6. Test the improved script
7. Report what you improved

Focus on:
- Finding new Iranian e-commerce sites
- Better bypass methods for blocked sites
- More accurate price extraction
- Direct product link generation
- Currency unit detection (Toman vs Rial)

Save improvements to /data/.hermes/scripts/price_search.py

jobs.name: Market Price Monitoring
jobs.prompt:
Market price monitoring job. Run every 3 hours. Check prices from MULTIPLE Iranian and international sources:

**🥇 Gold/Coin (IRAN - multiple sources):**
- https://www.iranjib.ir/showgroup/23/realtime_price/ (primary)
- https://talasea.ir/ (cross-check)
- https://mesghal.com/ (gold/coin prices)
- https://www.tgju.org/profile/price_gold_18 (18k gold)
- https://www.tgju.org/profile/price_gold_24 (24k gold)

**💵 Currency/USDT (IRAN):**
- https://bonbast.com/ (free market USD, EUR, GBP, USDT)
- https://www.tgju.org/profile/price_dollar_rl (dollar free market)
- https://www.tgju.org/profile/price_usdt_rl (USDT free market)
- https://bestchange.com/ (USDT rates from exchangers)

**₿ Crypto (International):**
- https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/cryptocurrency/listing?start=1&limit=20&sortBy=market_cap&sortType=desc&convert=USD (BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, XRP)
- https://api.coindesk.com/v1/bpi/currentprice.json (BTC price)

**🛢️ Oil (International):**
- https://www.oilprice.com/ (Brent, WTI)
- https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/ (oil news + prices)

**📰 Middle East News (for alerts):**
- https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/
- https://www.aljazeera.net/where/middle-east

**📈 Telegram Channels for Market Analysis (gold, currency, crypto, economic analysis):**
- @talasea_ir → https://t.me/talasea_ir
- @ecoshariff → https://t.me/ecoshariff
- @se_pz → https://t.me/se_pz
- @eco_roozbeh → https://t.me/eco_roozbeh

**Alert Conditions (each checked separately):**
1. Gold/Coin/Currency: Sudden change >5% vs last stored value
2. Major Middle East news: war, conflict, new sanctions, nuclear talks
3. Oil: >3% daily change
4. Telegram channel analysis: If channels report major market moves, policy changes, or breaking economic news

**Actions:**
1. Scrape/check ALL web sources above (use Playwright for JS sites, direct API for JSON endpoints)
2. Fetch recent posts from 4 Telegram channels via t.me web interface - extract market-relevant content (price predictions, breaking news, policy announcements, technical analysis)
3. For each asset, take median/average of available web sources (more reliable than single source)
4. Compare with last stored values in /data/.hermes/market_prices.json
5. If threshold exceeded OR Telegram channels signal major move → Send Telegram alert with: asset name, old/new price, % change, source links (web + Telegram)
6. Save new aggregated prices to JSON for next comparison
7. Silent if no alerts (no message on normal runs)

**Language:** Persian
**Tools:** Playwright (web), terminal (curl/API), file (JSON storage)

jobs.name: Gold Price Alert - talasea.ir
jobs.prompt:
Gold price monitoring from talasea.ir. Run every 30 minutes.

**Source:** https://talasea.ir/
- Scrape gold prices (18k, 24k per gram, mesghal, ounce)
- Also check coin prices if available

**Alert Condition:**
- Any gold price (18k, 24k, mesghal, ounce) changes >5% vs last stored value
- Compare with values saved in /data/.hermes/talasea_gold_prices.json

**Actions:**
1. Use Playwright to fetch https://talasea.ir/
2. Extract gold prices from the page
3. Compare with last stored prices in JSON file
4. If any gold price changed >5% → Send Telegram alert with:
   - Gold type (18k, 24k, mesghal, ounce)
   - Old price, new price, % change
   - Source link: https://talasea.ir/
5. Save new prices to /data/.hermes/talasea_gold_prices.json
6. Silent if no alerts (no message on normal runs)

**Language:** Persian
**Tools:** Playwright (web), file (JSON storage)

jobs.name: Middle East War/Conflict Alert - Telegram Channels
jobs.prompt:
Telegram channel monitoring for Middle East war/conflict alerts. Run every 3 hours.

**Telegram Channels to Monitor (via t.me web interface):**
1. @iranintltv → https://t.me/iranintltv
2. @km_ap → https://t.me/km_ap
3. @ne_wg → https://t.me/ne_wg
4. @tasnimnews → https://t.me/tasnimnews
5. @tabzlive → https://t.me/tabzlive
6. @alibk3 → https://t.me/alibk3
7. @farsna → https://t.me/farsna
8. @khabari_18 → https://t.me/khabari_18

**What to Look For (Serious Alert Triggers):**
- Missile strikes / rocket attacks / drone attacks on any Middle East location
- Military engagement / direct conflict between nations
- Iran-specific: attacks on Iran, Iran's military actions, nuclear facility incidents
- Israel-Iran tensions, proxy conflicts (Hezbollah, Houthis, etc.)
- US military movements in region, carrier strike groups
- Official war declarations, emergency alerts, air raid sirens
- Major escalation language: "جنگ", "موشک", "حمله", "درگیری", "تنش", "اخطار", "حالت جنگ"
- Casualty reports from military actions
- Border clashes, territorial disputes turning violent

**Actions:**
1. Fetch each channel's recent posts (last ~20 messages) via t.me/channelname web interface using Playwright
2. Extract message text, timestamps, and any media captions
3. Filter for SERIOUS conflict/war keywords (not routine political news)
4. Cross-reference: if multiple channels report same event → higher confidence
5. If SERIOUS alert detected → Send Telegram alert with:
   - Channel(s) reporting
   - Key message excerpt (translated/summarized)
   - Time of post
   - Direct link to t.me/channelname/message_id
   - Assessment: "Iran-direct" / "Regional escalation" / "Proxy conflict"
6. Save last checked message IDs to /data/.hermes/telegram_alert_state.json to avoid duplicate alerts
7. Silent if no serious alerts (no message on normal runs)

**Language:** Persian
**Tools:** Playwright (web), file (JSON storage)
**Priority:** HIGH - only alert on genuine military escalation, not political rhetoric

jobs.name: Daily Tech News Digest - AI, Gaming, SpaceX
jobs.prompt:
Tech news digest for AI, Gaming, SpaceX, and technology. Run daily at 13:00 Tehran time (09:30 UTC).

**Sources to Check (via web scraping/Playwright):**

**🤖 AI & Machine Learning:**
- https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/
- https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/
- https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence
- https://openai.com/blog/
- https://deepmind.google/discover/blog/
- https://huggingface.co/blog
- https://www.artificialintelligence-news.com/

**🎮 Gaming:**
- https://www.ign.com/
- https://www.gamespot.com/
- https://www.pcgamer.com/
- https://www.eurogamer.net/
- https://kotaku.com/
- https://www.gamedeveloper.com/

**🚀 SpaceX & Space:**
- https://www.spacex.com/updates/
- https://www.nasa.gov/news/
- https://www.space.com/
- https://arstechnica.com/space/
- https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/

**💻 General Tech:**
- https://www.theverge.com/
- https://arstechnica.com/
- https://www.wired.com/
- https://techcrunch.com/
- https://www.engadget.com/

**Actions:**
1. Fetch latest headlines (last 24-48 hours) from each source
2. Filter for SIGNIFICANT news only (major releases, breakthroughs, launches, acquisitions, major updates)
3. Skip: rumors, minor updates, opinion pieces, "how-to" articles

   - 📅 Date header (Jalali + Gregorian)
   - Category sections with 3-5 top items each
   - Each item: Title (Persian + English), 1-2 sentence summary, source link
   - 🚀 Highlight: SpaceX launches, major AI model releases, big game releases
6. Send to Telegram (always deliver, not silent - user wants daily digest)
7. Save last checked timestamps to /data/.hermes/tech_news_state.json to avoid duplicates

**Language:** Persian (Farsi)
**Format:** Clean, scannable digest with emojis and categories
**Tools:** Playwright (web), file (JSON storage)

jobs.name: Date Sync - Tehran Midnight
jobs.prompt:
Date synchronization task. Run daily at 00:00 Tehran time (20:30 UTC previous day).

**Purpose:** Ensure the agent always has the correct current date (Jalali and Gregorian) for accurate price reporting, news dating, and time-sensitive tasks.

**Actions:**
1. Get current date/time from system (Tehran timezone)
2. Format as both Jalali (Persian) and Gregorian
3. Save to /data/.hermes/current_date.json with structure:
   {
     "gregorian": "2026-07-27",
     "jalali": "1405-05-06",
     "day_name": "Monday",
     "day_name_fa": "دوشنبه",
     "updated_at": "2026-07-27T00:00:00+03:30",
     "timezone": "Asia/Tehran"
   }
4. Read the file in future runs to verify sync
5. Silent on success (no message), only alert if there's an error

**Commands to use:**
- `date` command with timezone
- Or use `curl` to a time API as backup

**Language:** Persian
**Tools:** terminal, file
